source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Public 63:19 and 64:1 partition Isa 63:19 at direct-child word 9/10; both hash the complete original record. Public 64:2–12 = Isa 64:1–11. Earlier 9:1 = Isa 8:23 and 9:2–21 = Isa 9:1–20 lie outside this scope. All other selected labels match.

delta_method: F0 retained wording; F1 lexical; F2 syntax/idiom; F3 consequential interpretive, textual, social, or versification choice. Editorial choices are independent of overlap scores. No minimum-change quota. Independent review has not occurred.

verses.rationale: Keep earth-wide devastation and four actions.
verses.before: Look, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
verses.after: Look! The **LORD** is emptying the earth, laying it waste, twisting its surface and scattering its people.
verses.tsw_comparator: Look, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

verses.rationale: Preserve six paired social relationships and specific female slavery.
verses.before: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
verses.after: It will be the same for people and priest, slave and master, slave woman and mistress, buyer and seller, lender and borrower, creditor and debtor.
verses.tsw_comparator: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

verses.rationale: Repeat emphatic destruction and speech authority.
verses.before: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.
verses.after: The earth will be utterly emptied, utterly plundered, for the **LORD** has spoken this word.
verses.tsw_comparator: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.

verses.rationale: Keep repeated withering and height image.
verses.before: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
verses.after: The earth mourns and withers; the world droops and withers; the earth’s highest people droop.
verses.tsw_comparator: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

verses.rationale: Retain three transgressions and covenant without naming a specific covenant.
verses.before: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.after: The earth is defiled beneath its inhabitants, for they have crossed the boundaries of instruction, violated the statute, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.tsw_comparator: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

verses.rationale: Keep doubled consequence, guilt, and scorching.
verses.before: So the curse has devoured the earth, and people who dwell in it are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.after: So a curse devours the earth, and its inhabitants bear their guilt. So earth’s inhabitants are scorched, and few people remain.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell in it are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

verses.rationale: Retain personified wine and reversal of joy.
verses.before: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
verses.after: New wine mourns, the vine droops; all the lighthearted sigh.
verses.tsw_comparator: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

verses.rationale: Repeat stopped joy and retain instruments.
verses.before: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of people who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
verses.after: The tambourines’ joy has stopped, the revelers’ noise has ceased, the lyre’s joy has stopped.
verses.tsw_comparator: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

verses.rationale: Keep changed drinking experience.
verses.before: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to people who drink it.
verses.after: They no longer drink wine with a song; strong drink tastes bitter to those who drink it.
verses.tsw_comparator: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

verses.rationale: Retain tohu emptiness and shut houses.
verses.before: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.after: The city of emptiness is shattered; every house is shut against entry.
verses.tsw_comparator: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

verses.rationale: Keep darkness and exile as joy images.
verses.before: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
verses.after: In the streets people cry out for wine. All gladness has darkened; earth’s joy has gone into exile.
verses.tsw_comparator: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

verses.rationale: Retain gate as concrete civic destruction.
verses.before: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
verses.after: Only desolation remains in the city; its gate is battered into ruins.
verses.tsw_comparator: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

verses.rationale: Keep remnant through two harvest comparisons.
verses.before: For it will be so among the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
verses.after: So it will be within the earth, among the peoples: as when an olive tree is beaten, as with gleanings when the grape harvest ends.
verses.tsw_comparator: For it will be so in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

verses.rationale: Preserve unexplained they and sea/west direction.
verses.before: These will lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.
verses.after: They lift their voices and sing for joy; from the west they shout at the **LORD**’s majesty.
verses.tsw_comparator: These will lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.

verses.rationale: Keep both divine names and geographic reach.
verses.before: So glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
verses.after: So honor the **LORD** in the east, the name of the **LORD**, Israel’s God, in the islands of the sea.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

verses.rationale: Preserve sudden lament and intensive betrayal repetition.
verses.before: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, "I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!" The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
verses.after: From earth’s edge we hear songs: “Splendor to the righteous!” But I say, “I waste away! I waste away! Woe to me! The treacherous betray; the treacherous betray with treachery!”
verses.tsw_comparator: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, "I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!" The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

verses.rationale: Retain threefold threat and singular address.
verses.before: Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabitant the earth.
verses.after: Terror, pit, and trap await you, inhabitant of the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabitant the earth.

verses.rationale: Keep chained escape failures and flood-like windows.
verses.before: It will happen that the one who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and the one who comes up out of the midst of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
verses.after: Whoever flees the sound of terror will fall into the pit; whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the trap. The windows on high have opened, and earth’s foundations shake.
verses.tsw_comparator: It will happen that the one who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and the one who comes up out of the midst of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

verses.rationale: Keep three intensified clauses.
verses.before: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
verses.after: The earth breaks apart, the earth splits open, the earth shakes violently.
verses.tsw_comparator: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

verses.rationale: Retain drunkard, shelter, and moral weight.
verses.before: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
verses.after: The earth reels like a drunkard, sways like a shelter. Its rebellion weighs heavily upon it; it falls and will not rise again.
verses.tsw_comparator: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

verses.rationale: Preserve matched heavenly and earthly realms.
verses.before: It will happen on that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
verses.after: On that day the **LORD** will call to account the host on high, on high, and earth’s kings, on earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

verses.rationale: Leave visitation open rather than specify release or punishment.
verses.before: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days will they be visited.
verses.after: They will be gathered like prisoners into a pit, shut away in a prison, and after many days they will be visited.
verses.tsw_comparator: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days will they be visited.

verses.rationale: Preserve celestial shame and elders without identifying them.
verses.before: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders will be glory.
verses.after: The moon will be abashed and the sun ashamed, for the **LORD** of hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and glory will be before his elders.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders will be glory.

verses.rationale: Keep personal praise and ancient faithful plans.
verses.before: O LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
verses.after: **LORD**, you are my God. I will exalt you and praise your name, for you have done wonders— plans from long ago, faithfully fulfilled.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

verses.rationale: Retain unnamed city and irreversible ruin.
verses.before: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
verses.after: You have made a city a heap, a fortified town a ruin. The foreigners’ palace is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

verses.rationale: Keep strength and ruthlessness distinct.
verses.before: So a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
verses.after: So a strong people will honor you; the city of ruthless nations will fear you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

verses.rationale: Keep poor/needy repetition and storm-wall text.
verses.before: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
verses.after: You have been a refuge for the poor, a refuge for the needy in distress, a shelter from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like a storm against a wall,
verses.tsw_comparator: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

verses.rationale: Retain heat-shade comparison across verse boundary.
verses.before: As the heat in a dry place will you bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
verses.after: like heat in a dry place. You subdue the foreigners’ uproar; as heat is subdued by a cloud’s shade, the song of the ruthless is brought low.
verses.tsw_comparator: As the heat in a dry place will you bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

verses.rationale: Preserve all peoples and luxurious repeated food/wine terms.
verses.before: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will make for all peoples a feast of rich food, a feast of well-aged wines, of rich food filled with marrow, of well-aged wines refined clear.
verses.after: On this mountain the **LORD** of hosts will prepare a feast for all peoples: rich food, aged wine, rich food full of marrow, aged wine well strained.
verses.tsw_comparator: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will make for all peoples a feast of rich food, a feast of well-aged wines, of rich food filled with marrow, of well-aged wines refined clear.

verses.rationale: Keep swallow verb linking covering with death.
verses.before: And on this mountain the LORD will destroy the covering that covers all peoples, the woven veil spread over all nations.
verses.after: On this mountain he will swallow up the covering spread over all peoples, the veil laid over all nations.
verses.tsw_comparator: And on this mountain the LORD will destroy the covering that covers all peoples, the woven veil spread over all nations.

verses.rationale: Retain death, all faces, and full divine designations.
verses.before: The LORD will swallow up death for ever. The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from every face, and will remove the disgrace of the people from all the earth, for the LORD has spoken.
verses.after: He will swallow up death forever. The Lord **GOD** will wipe tears from every face and remove his people’s disgrace from all the earth, for the **LORD** has spoken.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD will swallow up death for ever. The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from every face, and will remove the disgrace of the people from all the earth, for the LORD has spoken.

verses.rationale: Repeat waiting and divine identification.
verses.before: It will be said on that day, "Look, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!"
verses.after: On that day people will say, “Look, this is our God! We waited for him, and he saved us. This is the **LORD**; we waited for him. Let us rejoice and be glad in his salvation!”
verses.tsw_comparator: It will be said in that day, "Look, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!"

verses.rationale: Follow read-form in rather than written water-of; preserve degrading image.
verses.before: For in this mountain the hand of the LORD will rest. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
verses.after: The **LORD**’s hand will rest on this mountain, but Moab will be trampled where it stands, as straw is trampled in a dung pit.
verses.tsw_comparator: For in this mountain the hand of the LORD will rest. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

verses.rationale: Keep swimmer image and uncertain skill expression.
verses.before: He will spread out his hands in its midst, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.
verses.after: Moab will spread its hands in it as a swimmer spreads his hands to swim. But he will bring down Moab’s pride, despite the skill of its hands.
verses.tsw_comparator: He will spread out his hands in its midst, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

verses.rationale: Preserve direct-address shift and cumulative abasement.
verses.before: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.after: Your high, fortified walls he has brought down, laid low, struck to the ground, to the dust.
verses.tsw_comparator: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

verses.rationale: Keep salvation as defenses rather than add named builder.
verses.before: On that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
verses.after: On that day this song will be sung in Judah: “We have a strong city! He makes salvation its walls and rampart.
verses.tsw_comparator: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

verses.rationale: Preserve gate invitation and communal faithfulness.
verses.before: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
verses.after: Open the gates, so a righteous nation may enter, a nation that keeps faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

verses.rationale: Make doubled shalom audible without adding perfection.
verses.before: You keep in complete peace the one whose mind is stayed on you, because that one trusts in you.
verses.after: You keep in peace—peace— the mind that rests on you, because it trusts in you.
verses.tsw_comparator: You keep in complete peace the one whose mind is stayed on you, because that one trusts in you.

verses.rationale: Retain short and full names plus enduring rock.
verses.before: Trust in the LORD for ever, for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting rock.
verses.after: Trust in the **LORD** forever, for **YAH**, the **LORD**, is an everlasting rock.
verses.tsw_comparator: Trust in the LORD for ever, for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting rock.

verses.rationale: Repeat lowering of high city.
verses.before: For he has brought down people who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
verses.after: He has brought down those who live on high; the lofty city he lays low, lays it low to the ground, brings it to the dust.
verses.tsw_comparator: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

verses.rationale: Preserve formerly weak people as tramplers.
verses.before: The foot will tread it down; Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy."
verses.after: Feet trample it— the feet of the oppressed, the steps of the poor.”
verses.tsw_comparator: The foot will tread it down; Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy."

verses.rationale: Keep upright address interpretation and road image.
verses.before: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
verses.after: The path of the righteous is level. Upright One, you make the righteous person’s road smooth.
verses.tsw_comparator: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

verses.rationale: Keep judgments as path and name/remembrance pair.
verses.before: Yes, in the way of your judgments, the LORD, have we waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
verses.after: Along the path of your judgments, **LORD**, we wait for you. Your name, your remembrance, is our deepest desire.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yes, in the way of your judgments, the LORD, have we waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

verses.rationale: Retain night seeking and judgment as instruction.
verses.before: With my soul have I desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.after: With my whole being I desire you at night; with the spirit within me I seek you. When your judgments are on the earth, the world’s inhabitants learn righteousness.
verses.tsw_comparator: With my soul have I desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

verses.rationale: Keep failure despite favor without softening wickedness.
verses.before: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD's majesty.
verses.after: Show favor to the wicked, and they still do not learn righteousness. In a land of uprightness they do wrong and fail to see the **LORD**’s majesty.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD's majesty.

verses.rationale: Retain seeing repetition and fiery wish.
verses.before: O LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they do not see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
verses.after: **LORD**, your hand is raised, but they do not see. Let them see your zeal for your people and be ashamed; let the fire for your enemies consume them.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they do not see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

verses.rationale: Preserve divine agency over our works.
verses.before: O LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also worked all our works for us.
verses.after: **LORD**, you establish peace for us; everything we have accomplished, you have done for us.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also worked all our works for us.

verses.rationale: Keep contrast of other lords and divine name.
verses.before: The LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.
verses.after: **LORD** our God, other lords have ruled us; but through you alone we proclaim your name.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.

verses.rationale: Retain dead/shades parallel and finality before verse19 reversal.
verses.before: The dead will not live. The deceased will not rise. Therefore have you visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
verses.after: They are dead; they will not live. They are shades; they will not rise. You visited them and destroyed them, wiping away every memory of them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The dead will not live. The deceased will not rise. Therefore have you visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

verses.rationale: Repeat enlargement and preserve land boundaries.
verses.before: You have increased the nation, O the LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
verses.after: You have enlarged the nation, **LORD**, you have enlarged the nation; you are glorified. You have extended all the land’s boundaries.
verses.tsw_comparator: You have increased the nation, O the LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

verses.rationale: Render compressed whisper prayer with uncertainty noted.
verses.before: O LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
verses.after: **LORD**, in distress they sought you; they poured out a whispered prayer when your discipline was upon them.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

verses.rationale: Preserve labor simile and direct address.
verses.before: Like as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs; so we have been before you, the LORD.
verses.after: As a pregnant woman near delivery writhes and cries in labor, so we were before you, **LORD**.
verses.tsw_comparator: Like as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs; so we have been before you, the LORD.

verses.rationale: Retain failed birth and consequential fall/be-born ambiguity.
verses.before: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.after: We conceived, we writhed, but gave birth only to wind. We brought no salvation to the earth; no inhabitants of the world were born.
verses.tsw_comparator: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

verses.rationale: Preserve unusual my-corpse wording and birth reversal with note.
verses.before: Your dead will live. My dead bodies will arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast forth the dead.
verses.after: Your dead will live; my dead body will rise. Wake and sing, you who dwell in dust! Your dew is a dew of light, and the earth will bring forth the shades.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your dead will live. My dead bodies will arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast forth the dead.

verses.rationale: Follow singular door read-form and temporary shelter.
verses.before: Come, my people, enter into your chambers, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
verses.after: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your door behind you. Hide for a little while, until the wrath passes.
verses.tsw_comparator: Come, my people, enter into your chambers, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

verses.rationale: Keep exposed evidence of violence.
verses.before: For, look, the LORD comes forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
verses.after: Look! The **LORD** comes out from his place to call earth’s inhabitants to account for their guilt. The earth will uncover its bloodshed and no longer conceal its slain.
verses.tsw_comparator: For, look, the LORD comes forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

verses.rationale: Retain named monster and three sword descriptions.
verses.before: On that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.after: On that day the **LORD**, with his hard, great, strong sword, will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent, Leviathan the twisting serpent, and kill the monster in the sea.
verses.tsw_comparator: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

verses.rationale: Follow pinned delightful reading rather than wine-vineyard.
verses.before: On that day, sing to her, "A pleasant vineyard!
verses.after: On that day, “A delightful vineyard—sing of it!
verses.tsw_comparator: In that day, sing to her, "A pleasant vineyard!

verses.rationale: Repeat guarding and retain continual watering.
verses.before: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.after: I, the **LORD**, guard it. I water it moment by moment; night and day I guard it so no one harms it.
verses.tsw_comparator: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

verses.rationale: Preserve wrath denial and hypothetical battle.
verses.before: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
verses.after: I have no wrath. If only briers and thorns confronted me in battle! I would march against them and burn them all together.
verses.tsw_comparator: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

verses.rationale: Retain alternative refuge and repeated peace.
verses.before: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me."
verses.after: Or let them take hold of my refuge, let them make peace with me— make peace with me.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me."

verses.rationale: Keep parallel names and expanding growth.
verses.before: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
verses.after: In days to come Jacob will take root; Israel will bud and blossom and fill the world with fruit.
verses.tsw_comparator: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

verses.rationale: Clarify Jacob referent while retaining complex reciprocal question.
verses.before: Has he struck them as he struck people who struck them? Or are they killed like people who killed them were killed?
verses.after: Has he struck Jacob as he struck those who struck him? Has Jacob been killed as his killers were killed?
verses.tsw_comparator: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

verses.rationale: Retain difficult measured phrase and you/he shift.
verses.before: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
verses.after: By measured expulsion you contend with her; he drove her away with his harsh wind on a day of east wind.
verses.tsw_comparator: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

verses.rationale: Keep atonement tied to destruction of cult objects.
verses.before: So, by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherim and the incense altars will rise no more.
verses.after: By this, then, Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for; this is the full fruit of removing his sin: when he makes every altar stone like crushed chalk, and no Asherah poles or incense altars remain standing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore, by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherim and the incense altars will rise no more.

verses.rationale: Retain city’s returning animals and stripped growth.
verses.before: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
verses.after: The fortified city stands alone, a settlement deserted and abandoned like the wilderness. There a calf grazes and lies down, consuming its branches.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

verses.rationale: Preserve women gathering fuel and withheld compassion.
verses.before: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore the one who made them will not have compassion on them, and the one who formed them will show them no favor.
verses.after: When its branches dry, they are broken; women come and light fires with them. For this people has no understanding; so its Maker will not show it compassion, and its Former will not favor it.
verses.tsw_comparator: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore the one who made them will not have compassion on them, and the one who formed them will show them no favor.

verses.rationale: Keep geographical span and individual gathering.
verses.before: It will happen on that day, that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
verses.after: On that day the **LORD** will thresh from the River’s flowing waters to the Wadi of Egypt; and you, Israelites, will be gathered one by one.
verses.tsw_comparator: It will happen in that day, that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

verses.rationale: Retain two diaspora locations and return to worship.
verses.before: It will happen on that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and people who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and people who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, will come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
verses.after: On that day a great ram’s horn will sound. Those lost in Assyria and those driven away to Egypt will come and worship the **LORD** on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
verses.tsw_comparator: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, will come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

verses.rationale: Keep crown/city metaphor and intoxicated people.
verses.before: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of people who are overcome with wine!
verses.after: Woe to the proud crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, the fading flower of its glorious beauty, set above a fertile valley— to those struck down by wine!
verses.tsw_comparator: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

verses.rationale: Preserve unnamed agent and storm comparisons.
verses.before: Look, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
verses.after: Look! The Lord has someone strong and mighty. Like a hailstorm, a destructive tempest, like a torrent of mighty, flooding waters, he will hurl it to the ground with his hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: Look, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

verses.rationale: Repeat crown phrase from verse1.
verses.before: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.
verses.after: The proud crown of Ephraim’s drunkards will be trampled underfoot.
verses.tsw_comparator: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

verses.rationale: Keep effortless consumption of first fig.
verses.before: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, will be like the first-ripe fig before the summer; which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.
verses.after: That fading flower of glorious beauty, set above a fertile valley, will be like an early fig before summer: whoever sees it swallows it as soon as it reaches the hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, will be like the first-ripe fig before the summer; which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

verses.rationale: Preserve reversal from drunkards’ crown to divine crown.
verses.before: On that day, the LORD of Hosts will become a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the residue of his people;
verses.after: On that day the **LORD** of hosts will be a beautiful crown, a glorious wreath, for the remnant of his people,
verses.tsw_comparator: In that day, the LORD of Hosts will become a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the residue of his people;

verses.rationale: Keep judicial and military roles distinct.
verses.before: and a spirit of justice to the one who sits in judgment, and strength to people who turn back the battle at the gate.
verses.after: a spirit of justice for the one who sits in judgment, and strength for those who turn battle back at the gate.
verses.tsw_comparator: and a spirit of justice to the one who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

verses.rationale: Retain accumulated drunkenness and failed guidance.
verses.before: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.
verses.after: These too reel from wine and stagger from strong drink: priest and prophet reel from strong drink, swallowed by wine, staggering from strong drink. They reel in their visions and stumble in judgment.
verses.tsw_comparator: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

verses.rationale: Keep disgust without euphemism.
verses.before: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.
verses.after: Every table is covered with vomit and filth; no spot is clean.
verses.tsw_comparator: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

verses.rationale: Render mocking questions without invented speaker identity.
verses.before: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? People who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?
verses.after: “Whom is he teaching knowledge? To whom is he explaining the message? Children just weaned from milk, just taken from the breast?
verses.tsw_comparator: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

verses.rationale: Preserve repeated syllabic rhythm and note wordplay uncertainty.
verses.before: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
verses.after: For it is rule upon rule, rule upon rule, line upon line, line upon line, a little here, a little there!”
verses.tsw_comparator: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

verses.rationale: Keep foreign speech response to mockery.
verses.before: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language;
verses.after: Indeed, with stammering lips and another tongue he will speak to this people,
verses.tsw_comparator: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language;

verses.rationale: Retain rest repetition and refusal.
verses.before: to whom he said, "This is the resting place. Give rest to weary;" and "This is the refreshing;" yet they would not hear.
verses.after: to whom he said, “This is rest; let the weary rest. This is refreshment.” But they refused to listen.
verses.tsw_comparator: to whom he said, "This is the resting place. Give rest to weary;" and "This is the refreshing;" yet they would not hear.

verses.rationale: Repeat exact refrain and purposive consequence.
verses.before: So the word of the LORD will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.
verses.after: So the **LORD**’s word will become for them rule upon rule, rule upon rule, line upon line, line upon line, a little here, a little there— so they go and stumble backward, are broken, snared, and captured.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore the word of the LORD will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.

verses.rationale: Make ruling audience explicit.
verses.before: So hear the word of the LORD, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
verses.after: Therefore hear the **LORD**’s word, you mockers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

verses.rationale: Retain rulers’ shocking self-description and mixed flood/scourge image.
verses.before: "Because you have said, 'We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol are we in agreement. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it will not come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.'"
verses.after: You say, “We have made a covenant with death, an agreement with Sheol. When the sweeping scourge passes through, it will not reach us, for we have made lies our shelter and hidden ourselves in falsehood.”
verses.tsw_comparator: "Because you have said, 'We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol are we in agreement. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it will not come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.'"

verses.rationale: Retain tested foundation and haste verb rather than shame.
verses.before: So thus says the Lord GOD, "Look, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. the one who believes will not act hastily.
verses.after: So the Lord **GOD** says: “Look, I am laying a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a firm foundation. Whoever trusts will not rush in panic.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD, "Look, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. the one who believes will not act hastily.

verses.rationale: Keep building measurements and destroyed false refuge.
verses.before: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
verses.after: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the plumb line. Hail will sweep away the shelter of lies; water will flood the hiding place.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

verses.rationale: Repeat covenant language and violent undoing.
verses.before: Your covenant with death will be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
verses.after: Your covenant with death will be annulled; your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the sweeping scourge passes through, you will be trampled beneath it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your covenant with death will be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

verses.rationale: Retain recurrence and message-understanding reversal.
verses.before: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message."
verses.after: Every time it passes through, it will take you. Morning after morning it will pass through, by day and by night. Understanding the message will bring sheer terror.”
verses.tsw_comparator: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message."

verses.rationale: Keep concrete inadequate shelter proverb.
verses.before: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
verses.after: The bed is too short to stretch out on; the blanket too narrow to wrap yourself in.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

verses.rationale: Preserve unusual divine work and named battle echoes.
verses.before: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and accomplish his act, his extraordinary act.
verses.after: The **LORD** will rise as at Mount Perazim, will rage as in Gibeon’s valley, to do his deed—his strange deed, to perform his work—his foreign work.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

verses.rationale: Retain authorized warning and scope.
verses.before: Now therefore do not be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord GOD of Hosts, on the entire earth.
verses.after: Now stop mocking, lest your bonds grow tighter. For I have heard from the Lord **GOD** of hosts of destruction decreed against all the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now therefore do not be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord GOD of Hosts, on the whole earth.

verses.rationale: Keep paired appeals before farming instruction.
verses.before: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!
verses.after: Listen closely to my voice; pay attention and hear what I say.
verses.tsw_comparator: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!

verses.rationale: Retain rhetorical limit on preparatory labor.
verses.before: Does the one who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
verses.after: Does a plowman plow all day to sow, continually opening and harrowing his soil?
verses.tsw_comparator: Does the one who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

verses.rationale: Preserve five crops and differentiated sowing.
verses.before: When he has leveled its surface, does not he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?
verses.after: Once he has leveled its surface, does he not scatter black cumin, sow cumin, plant wheat in rows, barley in its place, and spelt along the edge?
verses.tsw_comparator: When he has leveled its surface, does not he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

verses.rationale: Keep agricultural skill as divine teaching.
verses.before: For his God instructs him in right judgment, and teaches him.
verses.after: His God instructs him in the right way and teaches him.
verses.tsw_comparator: For his God instructs him in right judgment, and teaches him.

verses.rationale: Retain different tools and repeated spice names.
verses.before: For the dill are not threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.
verses.after: Black cumin is not threshed with a threshing sledge, nor is a cartwheel rolled over cumin. Black cumin is beaten with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the dill are not threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.

verses.rationale: Retain difficult crushing distinction with note.
verses.before: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses do not grind it.
verses.after: Grain for bread is crushed, but one does not thresh it forever. He drives his cartwheel and horses over it without grinding it to pieces.
verses.tsw_comparator: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses do not grind it.

verses.rationale: Connect skill and wise counsel without sermon.
verses.before: This also comes forth from the LORD of Hosts, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
verses.after: This too comes from the **LORD** of hosts, wonderful in counsel, great in resourcefulness.
verses.tsw_comparator: This also comes forth from the LORD of Hosts, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

verses.rationale: Keep repeated symbolic name and liturgical cycle.
verses.before: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;
verses.after: Woe, Ariel, Ariel, city where David camped! Add year to year; let the festivals come around.
verses.tsw_comparator: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;

verses.rationale: Expose Ariel wordplay while noting uncertain sense.
verses.before: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She will be to me as an altar hearth.
verses.after: I will press Ariel hard; there will be mourning and moaning. She will become like an altar hearth to me.
verses.tsw_comparator: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She will be to me as an altar hearth.

verses.rationale: Keep first-person divine siege and equipment.
verses.before: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.
verses.after: I will encamp all around you, lay siege to you with posts, and raise siegeworks against you.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

verses.rationale: Preserve ghostlike reduced voice and dust repetition.
verses.before: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.
verses.after: Brought low, you will speak from the ground; your words will sink into the dust. Your voice will come from the ground like a ghost’s, your speech will chirp from the dust.
verses.tsw_comparator: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

verses.rationale: Retain abrupt reversal and unnamed foreigners.
verses.before: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.
verses.after: Yet the throng of your foreigners will become fine dust, the throng of the ruthless like drifting chaff. Suddenly, in an instant,
verses.tsw_comparator: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.

verses.rationale: Preserve visitation rather than specify rescue within verb.
verses.before: She will be visited by the LORD of Hosts with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
verses.after: the **LORD** of hosts will visit you with thunder, earthquake, and great noise, whirlwind, tempest, and devouring flame.
verses.tsw_comparator: She will be visited by the LORD of Hosts with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

verses.rationale: Keep siege forces becoming insubstantial.
verses.before: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even everyone who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
verses.after: The throng of all nations fighting Ariel, all who wage war against her and her stronghold, all who press her hard, will be like a dream, a vision at night.
verses.tsw_comparator: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

verses.rationale: Retain both unsatisfied appetite dreams.
verses.before: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and look, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger is not satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and look, he drinks; but he awakes, and look, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.
verses.after: As a hungry person dreams of eating and wakes with an empty stomach, as a thirsty person dreams of drinking and wakes faint and still thirsty, so will be the throng of all nations fighting Mount Zion.
verses.tsw_comparator: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and look, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger is not satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and look, he drinks; but he awakes, and look, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

verses.rationale: Keep commands then third-person observation.
verses.before: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
verses.after: Stupefy yourselves and be stupefied! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunk, but not from wine; they stagger, but not from strong drink.
verses.tsw_comparator: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

verses.rationale: Preserve eyes/heads identified with prophetic figures.
verses.before: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.
verses.after: For the **LORD** has poured over you a spirit of deep sleep. He has closed your eyes—the prophets— and covered your heads—the seers.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

verses.rationale: Make literacy scene intelligible without removing sealed-scroll metaphor.
verses.before: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, "Read this, please;" and he says, "I cannot, for it is sealed:"
verses.after: For you the whole vision has become like the words of a sealed scroll. Give it to someone who can read and say, “Please read this,” and the answer is, “I cannot; it is sealed.”
verses.tsw_comparator: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, "Read this, please;" and he says, "I cannot, for it is sealed:"

verses.rationale: Keep second distinct inability and repeated request.
verses.before: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, "Read this, please;" and he says, "I cannot read."
verses.after: Give the scroll to someone who cannot read and say, “Please read this,” and the answer is, “I cannot read.”
verses.tsw_comparator: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, "Read this, please;" and he says, "I cannot read."

verses.rationale: Retain mouth/lips/heart contrast and taught reverence.
verses.before: The Lord said: “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, while their heart is far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment learned by rote,
verses.after: The Lord said: “This people approaches me with its mouth and honors me with its lips, but its heart is far from me. Its fear of me is a human command learned by rote.
verses.tsw_comparator: The Lord said: “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, while their heart is far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment learned by rote,

verses.rationale: Keep repeated wonders and failed wisdom.
verses.before: so, look, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden."
verses.after: So I will again astound this people, with wonder upon wonder. The wisdom of its wise will perish, and the discernment of its discerning will disappear.”
verses.tsw_comparator: therefore, look, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden."

verses.rationale: Retain concealment depth and paired questions.
verses.before: Woe to people who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose works are in the dark, and who say, "Who sees us?" and "Who knows us?"
verses.after: Woe to those who bury their plans deep from the **LORD**, whose deeds are done in darkness, who say, “Who sees us? Who knows us?”
verses.tsw_comparator: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose works are in the dark, and who say, "Who sees us?" and "Who knows us?"

verses.rationale: Keep creator/creation reversal and two denials.
verses.before: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay; that the thing made should say about the one who made it, "He did not make me;" or the thing formed say of the one who formed it, "He has no understanding?"
verses.after: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be regarded as clay? Should a thing made say of its maker, “He did not make me,” or a formed thing say of its former, “He has no understanding”?
verses.tsw_comparator: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay; that the thing made should say about the one who made it, "He did not make me;" or the thing formed say of the one who formed it, "He has no understanding?"

verses.rationale: Preserve landscape reversal without imposed allegory.
verses.before: Isn't it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?
verses.after: In just a little while, will not Lebanon become fruitful land, and fruitful land be regarded as forest?
verses.tsw_comparator: Isn't it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

verses.rationale: Link inaccessible scroll to restored hearing.
verses.before: On that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
verses.after: On that day the deaf will hear a scroll’s words, and out of gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
verses.tsw_comparator: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

verses.rationale: Retain social lowliness and Holy One designation.
verses.before: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.after: The lowly will find fresh joy in the **LORD**; the poorest people will rejoice in Israel’s Holy One.
verses.tsw_comparator: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.rationale: Keep three groups and watchfulness for wrong.
verses.before: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all people who are alert to do evil are cut off—
verses.after: For the ruthless will be gone, the mocker finished, and all who watch for a chance to do evil will be cut off—
verses.tsw_comparator: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—

verses.rationale: Preserve corrupt judicial setting and word ambiguity.
verses.before: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.
verses.after: those who make a person guilty by a word, set a trap for the one who argues a case at the gate, and with empty claims deny justice to the righteous.
verses.tsw_comparator: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

verses.rationale: Keep Abraham redemption statement and collective Jacob.
verses.before: So thus says the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob will no longer be ashamed, neither will his face grow pale.
verses.after: Therefore the **LORD**, who redeemed Abraham, says to Jacob’s house: “Jacob will no longer be ashamed; his face will no longer grow pale.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore thus says the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob will no longer be ashamed, neither will his face grow pale.

verses.rationale: Preserve shifts between Jacob and children and holiness repetition.
verses.before: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, among him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.after: When he sees his children, the work of my hands, in his midst, they will honor my name as holy; they will honor Jacob’s Holy One as holy and stand in awe of Israel’s God.
verses.tsw_comparator: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

verses.rationale: Retain two restored responses.
verses.before: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and people who grumble will receive instruction."
verses.after: Those whose spirits wander will gain understanding; those who grumble will learn instruction.”
verses.tsw_comparator: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction."

verses.rationale: Choose alliance sense for pouring/covering phrase and note ambiguity.
verses.before: "Woe to the rebellious children," says the LORD, "who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin,
verses.after: “Woe to rebellious children,” declares the **LORD**, “who carry out plans that are not mine, who make an alliance without my Spirit, adding sin to sin.
verses.tsw_comparator: "Woe to the rebellious children," says the LORD, "who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin,

verses.rationale: Keep unauthorized journey and paired protection images.
verses.before: who set out to go down into Egypt, and have not asked my advice; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.after: They go down to Egypt without asking my counsel, seeking refuge in Pharaoh’s protection, shelter in Egypt’s shade.
verses.tsw_comparator: who set out to go down into Egypt, and have not asked my advice; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

verses.rationale: Repeat protection terms with reversal.
verses.before: So the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
verses.after: But Pharaoh’s protection will bring you shame, and shelter in Egypt’s shade, humiliation.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

verses.rationale: Keep his uncertain referent and two Egyptian places.
verses.before: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.
verses.after: Though his officials are in Zoan and his messengers reach Hanes,
verses.tsw_comparator: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

verses.rationale: Follow shame read-form and repeated failed benefit.
verses.before: They will all be ashamed because of a people that cannot profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach."
verses.after: all are put to shame by a people who cannot benefit them, who offer neither help nor advantage, only shame and disgrace.”
verses.tsw_comparator: They will all be ashamed because of a people that cannot profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach."

verses.rationale: Keep burden/oracle heading, all animals, and costly embassy.
verses.before: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.
verses.after: An oracle concerning the beasts of the Negeb: Through a land of distress and hardship, of lioness and lion, viper and flying fiery serpent, they carry wealth on donkeys’ shoulders, treasures on camels’ humps, to a people who cannot benefit them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

verses.rationale: Retain breath, symbolic Rahab, and inactive boast.
verses.before: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; so have I called her Rahab who sits still.
verses.after: Egypt’s help is breath and emptiness; so I call her “Rahab, sitting still.”
verses.tsw_comparator: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore have I called her Rahab who sits still.

verses.rationale: Retain dual writing media and future testimony without emendation.
verses.before: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.
verses.after: Now go, write it on a tablet before them, inscribe it on a scroll, so it may remain for a coming day, forever and ever.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

verses.rationale: Keep children repetition and refusal to hear.
verses.before: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the law of the LORD;
verses.after: For they are a rebellious people, lying children, children unwilling to hear the **LORD**’s instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the law of the LORD;

verses.rationale: Retain ironic commands addressed to seers.
verses.before: who tell the seers, "Don't see!" and to the prophets, "Don't prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.
verses.after: They say to those who see, “Do not see!” and to the seers, “Do not see straight for us! Tell us smooth things; see illusions.
verses.tsw_comparator: who tell the seers, "Don't see!" and to the prophets, "Don't prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

verses.rationale: Keep path pair and shocking dismissal.
verses.before: Get out of the way. Turn aside from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us."
verses.after: Leave the way! Turn aside from the path! Get Israel’s Holy One out of our sight!”
verses.tsw_comparator: Get out of the way. Turn aside from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us."

verses.rationale: Preserve rejected word and chosen dependencies.
verses.before: So thus says the Holy One of Israel, "Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it;
verses.after: So Israel’s Holy One says: “Because you reject this word and trust in oppression and crookedness, leaning on them,
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel, "Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it;

verses.rationale: Keep visible structural failure image.
verses.before: so this iniquity will be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.
verses.after: this guilt will be like a widening breach bulging in a high wall, whose collapse comes suddenly, in an instant.
verses.tsw_comparator: therefore this iniquity will be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.

verses.rationale: Preserve two mundane uses lost in total destruction.
verses.before: He will break it as a potter's vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there will not be found among the broken piece a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern."
verses.after: It will shatter like a potter’s jar, crushed without mercy, not a shard among its fragments large enough to scoop fire from a hearth or dip water from a cistern.”
verses.tsw_comparator: He will break it as a potter's vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there will not be found among the broken piece a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern."

verses.rationale: Retain returning rather than silently specify conversion.
verses.before: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, "You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence." You refused,
verses.after: For the Lord **GOD**, Israel’s Holy One, says: “In returning and rest you will be saved; in quietness and trust will be your strength.” But you were unwilling.
verses.tsw_comparator: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, "You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence." You refused,

verses.rationale: Keep matching boast and consequence verbs.
verses.before: but you said, "No, for we will flee on horses;" therefore you will flee; and, "We will ride on the swift;" therefore people who pursue you will be swift.
verses.after: You said, “No! We will flee on horses!” Therefore you will flee. “We will ride swift mounts!” Therefore your pursuers will be swift.
verses.tsw_comparator: but you said, "No, for we will flee on horses;" therefore you will flee; and, "We will ride on the swift;" therefore those who pursue you will be swift.

verses.rationale: Preserve thousand/one/five and isolated mast.
verses.before: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.
verses.after: A thousand will flee at one person’s threat; at the threat of five you will flee, until what remains of you is like a mast on a mountaintop, like a signal on a hill.
verses.tsw_comparator: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

verses.rationale: Keep reciprocal waiting and second divine name.
verses.before: So the LORD will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for the LORD is a God of justice. Blessed are all people who wait for him.
verses.after: Yet the **LORD** waits to show you favor; he rises to have compassion on you. For the **LORD** is a God of justice. Happy are all who wait for him!
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore the LORD will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for the LORD is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

verses.rationale: Make collective address readable; preserve immediate answer.
verses.before: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.
verses.after: People in Zion, dwelling in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. He will surely show you favor at the sound of your cry; as soon as he hears, he will answer.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

verses.rationale: Choose singular teacher from contextual verb and note plural possibility.
verses.before: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers will not be hidden anymore, but your eyes will see your teachers;
verses.after: Though the Lord gives you bread of distress and water of oppression, your Teacher will no longer hide; your eyes will see your Teacher.
verses.tsw_comparator: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers will not be hidden anymore, but your eyes will see your teachers;

verses.rationale: Keep guidance from behind and both directions.
verses.before: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, "This is the way. Walk in it."
verses.after: Your ears will hear a word behind you: “This is the way; walk in it,” whenever you turn right or left.
verses.tsw_comparator: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, "This is the way. Walk in it."

verses.rationale: Retain menstrual comparison rather than generic unclean thing.
verses.before: You will defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You will cast them away as an unclean thing. You will tell it, "Go away!"
verses.after: You will defile the silver plating of your carved idols and the gold covering of your cast images. You will scatter them like a menstrual cloth and say, “Away with you!”
verses.tsw_comparator: You will defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You will cast them away as an unclean thing. You will tell it, "Go away!"

verses.rationale: Preserve soil repetition and abundant food for people/animals.
verses.before: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. On that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.
verses.after: He will give rain for the seed you sow in the soil, and the soil’s grain will be rich and plentiful. On that day your livestock will graze in spacious pasture.
verses.tsw_comparator: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

verses.rationale: Retain quality fodder and both implements.
verses.before: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory provender, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.
verses.after: The oxen and donkeys that work the soil will eat seasoned fodder, winnowed with shovel and fork.
verses.tsw_comparator: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory provender, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

verses.rationale: Keep slaughter alongside restored water.
verses.before: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.after: On every high mountain and lofty hill there will be streams of running water, on the day of great slaughter when the towers fall.
verses.tsw_comparator: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

verses.rationale: Preserve sevenfold light and injury attributed to divine blow.
verses.before: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.
